description: Whether an LLM's measured performance has shifted: AI Stupid Level's drift signature for one model, with its regime (stable, degrading, …), current score against its baseline, the change-point detector per benchmark suite, the last significant change and which axes moved. Use it to answer "has model X got worse?" or "is X being nerfed?".

model.description: The model: its numeric id, its name (for example claude-opus-5-5 or gpt-6-sol) or its display name. get_leaderboard lists the tracked models with their ids.
